entry.name: jit.poke~
entry.digest: Write an audio signal into a matrix
entry.description: jit.poke~ writes the value specified by the leftmost signal input into one plane of a matrix cell at the position specified by the signal inputs (following the leftmost input). The object arguments are [matrix_name] [dim_inputcount] [plane].

arguments.name: matrix_name
arguments.description: The name of the matrix to access (default = none)

arguments.name: dim_inputcount
arguments.description: The number of dimensions in the matrix (default = 2)

arguments.name: plane
arguments.digest: Plane for cell value to be replaced by leftmost input
arguments.description: The plane in a cell whose value is replaced by leftmost input (default = 0)
